name: Gauntlet
summary: Installs, uses, uninstalls and reinstalls Automaton on your test machines on a schedule and reports failures.
description: Runs test plans over SSH on machines you name: wipe and install Automaton, check the default apps, deploy an app, back up, restart, uninstall and reinstall, and weekly restore the newest off-site backup on a disposable machine. Plans that wipe run only on machines marked disposable. Each plan is an Action with a schedule you can change in Studio. Runs and logs are kept; a failed run emails you, gets a Claude Code diagnosis and opens one GitHub issue.

application.description: Runs install, use, uninstall and reinstall tests on your own machines on a schedule and reports failures by email and GitHub issue.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py gauntlet.py failures.py && mkdir -p .pip-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.pip-tmp pip install --quiet --cache-dir .pip-tmp/cache --target dist/lib 'paramiko>=3,<5' && rm -rf .pip-tmp && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp -r main.py gauntlet.py failures.py index.html gauntlet.js gauntlet.css plans dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: TARGETS
settings.description: The machines to test, as a JSON list of name, host, domain and disposable (see the README). Plans that wipe a machine run only where disposable is true

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets failure emails (needs the notify:email permission approved): administrators, owner, project or an address an administrator allowed; separate several with commas

settings.name: ISSUE_REPOS
settings.description: GitHub repositories a failure may open an issue in, as owner/name separated by commas. Empty: no issues, only emails

settings.name: BOARDS
settings.description: Optional project board per repository, as JSON (see the README). New issues are added to it

settings.name: CLAUDE_TARGET
settings.description: Name of the machine (from TARGETS) where Claude Code is installed and signed in. It diagnoses a failure there, read-only. Empty: issues carry the logs without a diagnosis

settings.name: CLAUDE_COMMAND
settings.description: The command that reads the prompt on standard input and prints one JSON answer on CLAUDE_TARGET

settings.name: DRILL_S3_ENDPOINT
settings.description: Restore drill: the S3-compatible endpoint of the off-site backup bucket (Cloudflare R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com)

settings.name: DRILL_S3_REGION
settings.description: Restore drill: the bucket's region (R2: auto)

settings.name: DRILL_S3_BUCKET
settings.description: Restore drill: the bucket that holds the off-site backups (under automaton/)

secrets.name: SSH_KEY
secrets.description: Private key (OpenSSH or PEM, no passphrase) that may sign in to every machine in TARGETS. Use a key made for Gauntlet, never the production key

secrets.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: At least 16 characters. The schedules use it to call the app and start a plan; outside Automaton it is the page's login

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: A token that may create issues and comments in ISSUE_REPOS (and add to the project boards). Empty: no issues

secrets.name: DRILL_BACKUP_KEY
secrets.description: Restore drill: the server's backup (age) private key. Gauntlet copies it to runner-02 only for the restore and deletes it afterwards

secrets.name: DRILL_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Restore drill: access key id of a read-only token (Object Read, that one bucket); never Backup Warden's key

secrets.name: DRILL_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: Restore drill: secret access key of that read-only token
